description: This file defines the TaxService interface, which declares methods for handling tax configurations and calculations related to a merchant store, including retrieving, saving configurations, and calculating tax over order summaries.

classes.name: TaxService
classes.description: Interface defining methods for managing tax configurations and calculating taxes in the e-commerce platform.

methods.name: getTaxConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves tax configuration settings for a specified merchant store.

methods.name: saveTaxConfiguration
methods.description: Saves or updates tax configuration settings for a merchant store.

methods.name: calculateTax
methods.description: Calculates applicable taxes on an order summary for a customer, store, and language context.
